item.title: Version 1.0.15
item.description:
What's new

  • Your pet has a present for you. Open it!
  • Snow falls across your screen and settles on your windows. Turn on "Let it snow" in the menu bar and it keeps snowing until you turn it off again.
  • Your pet now has a room. Finished tasks and focus time earn stars for furniture.
  • Your pet dances when your music plays.
  • Good night ritual: end your day and your pet sums it up, yawns and goes to sleep under a blanket.
  • A little postcard of your week, ready to save or share.
  • Surprises for milestones, holidays and your birthday.
  • Every 25 minutes of focus now earns your pet a snack, no matter how long your focus round is.
